case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised the hotel's convenient location and plentiful breakfast, and several noted friendly, improving staff and clean, spacious rooms. However, reviewers also reported crowded breakfasts at peak times, narrow/tight parking, dated or poorly maintained room elements (curtains, minibar, windows), uncomfortable/hard beds, noise and poor sound insulation, and isolated service issues such as a disputed room-service charge and an unexplained early-morning alarm.

priorities.recommendation: Audit alarm, confirm cause; ensure announcements, reassurance, script training; verify/schedule maintenance; log and report centrally.
Inspect and document parking dimensions/turning radii; communicate restrictions/pricing, sign entrance, offer alternatives, consider re-pricing.
Implement deep-clean inspection checklist; prioritize repairs, tighten minibar/housekeeping checks, create refurbishment and hot-water maintenance plans.

priorities.area: Room comfort (beds, furniture, noise, room condition, pests)
priorities.recommendation: Initiate room-condition inspections; prioritize maintenance for safety/hygiene; compile medium-term refurbishment scope/cost estimate if widespread deterioration.
Review breakfast, 4‑star quality, and takeaway policy for consistent non-discriminatory application; consider adjustments after review.
Immediately check hot-water systems and inspect bathrooms; repair isolated failures, commission technical assessment if systemic.
